watch.en: Let meat rest before cutting it: about 10 minutes for a thick steak, half an hour for a large roast. Take it off the heat a little early, it goes on cooking.
watch.de: Fleisch vor dem Anschneiden ruhen lassen: etwa 10 Minuten bei einem dicken Steak, eine halbe Stunde bei einem großen Braten. Etwas früher von der Hitze nehmen, es gart nach.

why.en: As the meat cools a little it holds its juice better, so less runs out when it is cut; in one kitchen test a steak cut at once lost about 9 % of its weight as juice, a rested one about 2 %.
why.de: Leicht abgekühlt hält das Fleisch seinen Saft besser, sodass beim Schneiden weniger ausläuft; in einem Küchenversuch verlor ein sofort angeschnittenes Steak etwa 9 % seines Gewichts als Saft, ein geruhtes etwa 2 %.

sources.title: McGee on Food and Cooking (Harold McGee), Hodder & Stoughton 2004
sources.place: chapter Meat, After the Cooking: Resting, Carving, and Serving, p. 165
sources.sentence: Cooling therefore makes the meat easier to carve and reduces the amount of fluid lost during carving.

sources.title: McGee on Food and Cooking (Harold McGee), Hodder & Stoughton 2004
sources.place: chapter Meat, Heat and Meat Texture (paragraph before 'Knowing When to Stop Cooking'), p. 153
sources.sentence: and can range from a negligible few degrees in a thin cut to 20°F/10°C in a large roast.

sources.place: chapter 3 STEAKS, CHOPS, CHICKEN, FISH, and the Science of Fast-Cooking Foods, section THE IMPORTANCE OF RESTING MEAT
sources.sentence: Cut it open immediately, and you lose an additional 9 percent.
